Name: Shie-style Canon Compliant Clint
Author: xoPeridotTea
Description:
I really loved the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE's PORTRAITS[/url] mod, but it really bothered be how buff/muscular Clint was.  So, I decided to do a version of Clint that matched their style while being more in line with how soft Clint actually looks in-game.  It also makes Clint appear a little younger, which I think matches a little bit better.

This includes Clint's standard portraits, his Ginger Island portraits, and his 1.6 winter portraits.

[b]MOD REQUIREMENTS[/b]:
[list]
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[/list]
[b]To install the files:[/b]
1. unzip the .zip file
2. place the unzipped .png files in the SHIE'S PORTRAITS folder within your Portraiture mod folder
(i.e. - D:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Shie's Portraits)

Downloads.Description: Corrected Clint portrait so it will properly fit in the frame
